source: Live tools/list from an active Scratchbox Canvas MCP session (scratchbox.ai/api/mcp/canvas), captured via an in-IDE agent session with the server already connected. Refresh with: node scripts/generate_mcp_docs.mjs --live

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_arrange_nodes
tools.description: Durably arrange selected Basic canvas nodes (or all top-level Basic nodes) in a grid, horizontal, vertical, or circle layout. Returns the saved positions.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_create_draft
tools.description: Create a Writer/Draft node on the active canvas with longer-form content.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_create_node
tools.description: Create one of the 13 native Basic tools with its UI-compatible defaults. No arbitrary data or Pro nodes; edit afterwards with canvas.update_node.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_create_note
tools.description: Persist a native text node on the active canvas. Returns the saved node.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_delete_node
tools.description: Move a single canvas node to trash by id.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_delete_nodes
tools.description: Move multiple canvas nodes to trash by id.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_duplicate_nodes
tools.description: Durably duplicate selected Basic canvas nodes with fresh ids and non-overlapping positions. Returns the saved copies.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_get_manifest
tools.description: Return a lightweight manifest of the active canvas — node ids/types/parents/positions and edge endpoints, without the heavy `data` payload. Designed for listing-style consumers and progressive hydration.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_get_node
tools.description: Return a single canvas node by id with its complete `data` payload.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_get_workspace
tools.description: Return a high-level summary of the active workspace: canvas id, name, node counts by type, edge count.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_group_into_box
tools.description: Group a list of existing canvas nodes into a Box (frame) container.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_list_nodes
tools.description: List every node on the active canvas with a short snippet per node. Returns up to `limit` nodes (default 50). Optional `nodeType` filter (e.g. "imageCard", "frame", "characterSheet", "videoCard", "locationNode", "note", "draft").

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_move_to_frame
tools.description: Move existing nodes into a target frame. Executes server-side: re-parents the nodes, converts their positions to frame-local coordinates, and grows the frame to contain them.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_rename_node
tools.description: Rename a node (sets data.label or data.title depending on node type).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_resize_node
tools.description: Durably resize a native Sticky Note, Presentation, or Box container. Saves bounded app-native dimensions and broadcasts the geometry update; it does not simulate pointer input.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_search
tools.description: Find canvas nodes by case-insensitive text match on text/prompt/title/label/fileName/character fields. Returns up to 20 results.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_set_aspect_ratio
tools.description: Set the project-wide default aspect ratio used by image/video generation.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_ungroup_nodes
tools.description: Remove nodes from their parent frame/box.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__canvas_update_node
tools.description: Edit supported Basic authoring fields only (text, settings, authored structure). Rejects arbitrary node data, media paths, ownership, runtime callbacks and no-ops.

data.description: Shape depends on node type: label/colorIndex (sticky/note), content/title (writer/draft), presentationDeck.slides (presentation), aspectRatio (image/video), text/color (note), prompt/negativePrompt (image/video card), characterName/characterDescription (character sheet), query/sceneContext (location), storyboardState (storyboard), script fields (podcast), brandKit fields (brand kit), title/description/privacy (publishing).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_analyze_style
tools.description: Analyze the recurring visual style across 1–8 authorized workspace image cards. Returns a reusable style profile and bills the workspace owner for model usage.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_animate_image
tools.description: Queue a billed, durable Veo video generation conditioned on a workspace image card. Requires a stable idempotencyKey.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_compose_images
tools.description: Queue a billed composition from 2–4 images stored in the active workspace. Requires an idempotencyKey reused only for exact retries.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_create_ref_sheet
tools.description: Create a Basic Character Sheet brief and queue four billed durable views. Optionally condition the view jobs on a workspace image card; source pixels are loaded only by the guarded worker. Requires an idempotencyKey.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_describe_image
tools.description: Describe a workspace-stored image or answer a visual question about it. Reads an authorized image card and bills the workspace owner for model usage.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_edit_image
tools.description: Queue a billed, prompt-driven edit using an image stored in the active workspace. Requires an idempotencyKey reused only for exact retries.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_generate_images
tools.description: Queue 1–4 billed Nano Banana Pro images in the active workspace. Use prompts for different prompt variants or count for independent samples of one prompt. Alternatively provide recipeTheme to generate and use distinct Prompt Studio prompt recipes. Each output is a separate durable job and canvas image. Requires a unique idempotencyKey. (Auto-polls completion on scratchbox.ai and returns the direct public CDN image URL).

count.description: Number of independent images for prompt; each is billed separately.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller-generated key reused only when retrying this exact generation request.

maxEstimatedCost.description: Optional per-image maximum credit estimate; every image is checked independently before its job is queued.

prompts.description: One prompt per requested recipe/image. When supplied, count is not allowed.

recipeCount.description: Number of distinct recipe prompts to generate; defaults to 3. Only valid with recipeTheme.

recipeTheme.description: Generate distinct Prompt Studio prompt recipes for this visual theme, then queue one image per recipe. Mutually exclusive with prompt, prompts, and count.

waitForCompletion.description: Whether to wait for image generation to complete and return the public URL (default true).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_multi_angle_shots
tools.description: Queue up to four billed durable character views from a text-authored Character Sheet, or condition views on a workspace image card. Requires a stable idempotencyKey.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_reimagine_image
tools.description: Queue a billed, durable workspace image edit that reimagines the source image according to a prompt. Requires a durable workspace image and idempotencyKey.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_remove_object
tools.description: Queue a billed object removal using an image stored in the active workspace. Describe the object to remove. Requires an idempotencyKey reused only for exact retries.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_restyle_image
tools.description: Queue one billed Nano Banana Pro image restyle using an image stored in the active workspace. Requires an idempotencyKey reused only for exact retries.

prompt.description: Optional extra direction for the requested visual style.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_text_to_video
tools.description: Queue one Veo 3.1 video generation in the active workspace. Requires a unique idempotencyKey; the durable billed job stores the video and creates one canvas video node when complete.

duration.description: One supported Veo clip duration: 4, 6, or 8 seconds. Defaults to 8 seconds.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller-generated key reused only when retrying this exact generation request.

maxEstimatedCost.description: Optional maximum credit estimate; refuses to enqueue when the current estimate exceeds this amount.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_upscale_image
tools.description: Queue one billed Imagen/Real-ESRGAN upscale for a workspace image card. Requires a stable idempotencyKey reused only for an exact retry.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller-generated key reused only when retrying this exact upscale request.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_video_compose
tools.description: UNAVAILABLE HEADLESSLY: the existing route trusts browser-supplied nodes and media URLs, runs synchronously, and returns only an ephemeral prompt structure without workspace authorization, idempotency, cancellation, or persisted output. The Canvas Agent compose_timeline/render_timeline workflow requires the Pro Timeline node and is not a Basic-mode substitute. No provider call is made.

nodeIds.description: IDs of canvas nodes to compose from.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__ai_video_restyle
tools.description: Queue a billed, prompt-based restyle of a video stored in the active workspace. Requires an idempotencyKey reused only for exact retries. The durable job stores the output and creates a new canvas video node; poll operation.get or request operation.cancel.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller-generated key reused only when retrying this exact restyle request.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_compose
tools.description: UNAVAILABLE HEADLESSLY — same constraint as ai.video_compose: no provider call is made; use Pro Timeline in the interactive app.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_detect_scenes
tools.description: Detect scene boundaries in an authorized, workspace-stored video using the existing backend FFmpeg scene processor.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_extract_audio
tools.description: Extract the MP3 audio track with the backend FFmpeg processor and persist it as a new workspace audio node.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_generate
tools.description: Queue one Veo 3.1 video generation in the active workspace. Requires a unique idempotencyKey; the durable billed job stores the video and creates one canvas video node when complete.

duration.description: One supported Veo clip duration: 4, 6, or 8 seconds. Defaults to 8 seconds.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_restyle
tools.description: Queue a billed, prompt-based restyle of a video stored in the active workspace. Requires an idempotencyKey reused only for exact retries. The durable job stores the output and creates a new canvas video node; poll operation.get or request operation.cancel.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_restyle_with_preset
tools.description: Queue a billed video restyle using server-resolved pinned canvas/workspace presets, Style DNA, or the project bundle. Pinned values are read from authorized project storage and cannot be supplied by the caller. The job is bound to this canvas and source asset; retry with the same idempotencyKey only for the exact same request. Poll operation.get or request operation.cancel.

idempotencyKey.description: Required stable caller-generated key; reused only for retries of the exact same request.

presetRef.description: Choose server-resolved pinned canvas/workspace presets (default), workspace Style DNA, or the project style bundle.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_to_gif
tools.description: Convert a workspace-stored video to an animated GIF with the backend FFmpeg processor and persist it as a new canvas image node.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_transcribe
tools.description: Queue an idempotent, billed transcription of an authorized workspace video/audio node. The transcript is attached to the source canvas media node. Poll operation.get; operation.cancel requests cancellation.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__video_trim
tools.description: Trim a workspace-stored video node with the backend FFmpeg processor and persist the result as a new canvas video node.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_create_spoken_audio
tools.description: Persist a Basic Spoken Audio script node with speakers and optional authored lines. Does not synthesize audio, enqueue a job, or spend credits.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_draft_podcast_script
tools.description: Queue a billed durable Gemini drafting job for a Basic Spoken Audio node. The finished script is persisted on the node only after the job succeeds; it does not synthesize speech.

sourceNodeIds.description: Optional IDs of connected persisted Writer, PDF, note, or location sources.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_edit_audio
tools.description: Regenerate a selected segment of workspace audio with ACE-Step inpainting. The source must be an existing audio storage path in the active workspace; output is persisted as a new canvas audio card.

sourceAudioStoragePath.description: Workspace-scoped storage path of the source audio. Arbitrary external URLs are not accepted.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_extend_audio
tools.description: Extend workspace audio before/after with ACE-Step audio outpainting. The source must be an existing audio storage path in the active workspace. Output is persisted as a new canvas audio card.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_generate_dialogue
tools.description: Synthesize ordered Basic ScoreBox dialogue lines using configured Google prebuilt voices. Uses a billed durable job and persists verified audio to the active workspace and canvas.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_generate_lyrics
tools.description: Generate a real ACE-Step song from lyrics (or an instrumental when lyrics are omitted) and persist the playable output to workspace storage and the canvas. Requires a writable workspace, ScoreBox source node, and stable idempotencyKey.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_generate_sfx
tools.description: Generate an ElevenLabs SFX v2 sound effect from a description and persist the playable output to workspace storage and the canvas. Requires a writable workspace, ScoreBox source node, and stable idempotencyKey.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_preview_scorebox_voice
tools.description: Generate a real, short Google preset-voice audition for a Basic ScoreBox node. Requires writable active-workspace access and a stable idempotencyKey; queues a billed durable job that saves verified audio in workspace storage. Poll operation.get for the playable URL and storage path.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_preview_spoken_audio_voice
tools.description: Generate a real, short Google preset-voice audition for a speaker on a Basic Spoken Audio node. Uses the selected speaker's first authored line when text is omitted. Requires writable active-workspace access and a stable idempotencyKey; queues a billed durable job that saves verified audio in workspace storage. Poll operation.get for the playable URL and storage path.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_regenerate_podcast_script_line
tools.description: Regenerate exactly one authored Basic Spoken Audio line with the same billed Gemini model and prompt intent as the in-app action. Requires workspace write access and a stable idempotencyKey. The durable job compare-and-swaps the exact line identity and reports success only after the updated line is persisted to the canvas; generation failures or stale lines are refunded.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_restyle_audio
tools.description: Restyle workspace audio with ACE-Step audio-to-audio. The source must be an existing audio storage path in the active workspace; output is persisted as a new canvas audio card.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_synthesize_scorebox
tools.description: Generate real scorebox music from an authored ScoreBox node using the existing Google Lyria service. Requires a writable active workspace and a stable idempotencyKey; queues a billed durable job and creates an audio card only after durable workspace audio is verified.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_synthesize_spoken_audio
tools.description: Generate real speech for an authored Basic Spoken Audio node using its ordered script lines and configured Google prebuilt speaker voices. Requires a writable active workspace and a stable idempotencyKey; queues a billed durable job and creates an audio card only after actual audio is stored. Supports up to 32 script lines / 12,000 characters.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__audio_update_spoken_audio
tools.description: Persist authored topic, preset, target duration, speaker, or script changes on an existing Basic Spoken Audio node. Pass updated speakers/scriptLines when changing preset if they should be reset to match; does not synthesize audio or spend credits.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__scene3d_add_model
tools.description: Add a GLB/GLTF model to the active 3D scene.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__scene3d_add_primitive
tools.description: Add a primitive (box, sphere, cylinder, plane) to a 3D scene.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__scene3d_add_terrain
tools.description: Add a terrain layer (heightmap-based) to a 3D scene.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__scene3d_compose_scene
tools.description: Render the current 3D scene to an image card on the canvas.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__scene3d_create_3d_object
tools.description: Generate a 3D mesh from an image node (image-to-3D).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__scene3d_create_scene
tools.description: Create a new Scene 3D node on the canvas.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__scene3d_set_camera
tools.description: Set the active camera position, target, or FOV in a 3D scene.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__scene3d_set_environment
tools.description: Apply an atmosphere/environment preset (e.g. sunny, sunset, overcast, night).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_capture
tools.description: Capture a durable Google Maps 3D Tiles package for a resolved Basic Location node. Requires saved coordinates and an explicitly promoted matching Setting asset. This is provider map imagery, not an AI-generated concept image.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller-generated key reused only to retry the same capture request.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_create
tools.description: Persist a Basic Location node with authored query/context fields. This does not geocode, search maps, scout, or call an external provider.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_from_image
tools.description: Analyze a durable workspace image card for visual setting cues, then find candidate real places with billed live Google Maps grounding. Results include Maps evidence and are durably saved on the source image node; matches are candidates, not proof that the image depicts that place.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_geocode
tools.description: Search actual OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocoder results (non-paid), returning place names and coordinates. Results are search data only and are not persisted to the canvas.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_imagery
tools.description: Queue one billed, durable scouting image for an existing Basic Location using an actual Google Maps Street View Static API source at the node's saved coordinates. Requires verified outdoor coverage, a workspace/canvas write scope, and an idempotencyKey. Output is explicitly an AI rendering grounded in and cited to that real source.

heading.description: Google Street View camera heading in degrees. Defaults to 0.

prompt.description: Optional rendering direction. The worker still supplies the verified Street View source and requires the result to preserve its real place.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_package_download
tools.description: Return a short-lived, workspace-authorized download URL for a completed real Google Maps GLB package.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_package_status
tools.description: Read the durable capture job and package status saved on a Basic Location node.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_preview
tools.description: Search real OpenStreetMap place candidates for one or more queries and return map links with attribution. Read-only: does not create canvas nodes, access private assets, or generate map imagery.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_query
tools.description: Ask a question about an existing Basic Location using billed live Google Maps grounding. Answers require cited Maps place evidence and are saved durably on the Location node.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_scout
tools.description: Generate four billed, durable visual-scouting viewpoint images for an existing Basic Location node. Uses saved coordinates or real OpenStreetMap geocoding, then queues idempotent image jobs through the guarded workspace generation pipeline. Outputs are AI-generated concepts, not verified map captures or photographs.

placeId.description: OpenStreetMap Nominatim placeId used to disambiguate an unresolved location query.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__location_update
tools.description: Persist authored query/context fields on an existing Basic Location node. Does not geocode or scout.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_create
tools.description: Persist a Basic Writer document with authored title and content in the selected frame; no AI or provider calls.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_deep_write
tools.description: Queue an idempotent, billed Deep Write pipeline and persist its finished draft to a Writer node. Requires an idempotencyKey and either an existing writer node or target frame.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_embed_document
tools.description: Parse an existing authorized workspace PDF with the configured Document AI Layout Parser and save its extracted text plus verified source attachment on an existing Basic Writer node. Requires an idempotencyKey; no browser file picker or generated document is involved.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_export_pdf
tools.description: Generate a PDF from the selected Writer node, store it under the active workspace, and return a signed download URL plus verified size and SHA-256.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_export_presentation
tools.description: Export the authored deck from the named Presentation node to PPTX, or create a Google Slides presentation in the user's connected Google Drive. Google Slides delivery requires an idempotencyKey and returns a durable deliveryJobId; call writer.google_slides_delivery_status to retrieve its final status and verified external presentation ID/URL.

format.description: "pptx" for a PowerPoint download. "google-slides" creates a new Slides presentation in the connected account. Default: pptx.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for Google Slides. Reuse only to retry the exact same delivery request.

nodeId.description: ID of the existing Presentation node whose authored deck to export. Required for headless PPTX export.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_google_slides_delivery_status
tools.description: Read the durable status of a Google Slides delivery job started by this account. A completed result includes the verified external Google presentation ID and URL.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_presentation_add_media
tools.description: Place selected image/video cards from this canvas onto one authored Presentation slide. The source objects must be durable, accessible workspace media; no provider calls are made.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_presentation_generate_media
tools.description: Queue one billed, durable image or video generation using copy and speaker notes from an authorized authored Presentation slide. The worker attaches the verified workspace-stored result to that same slide. This response confirms only that a durable job was queued, not that generation has completed.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_presentation_rewrite_slide
tools.description: Rewrite the copy on one authored Presentation slide using the metered Presentation copywriter, preserve its visual elements, and persist the updated deck. Requires workspace write access and sufficient credits.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_transform_selected_text
tools.description: MANUAL-ONLY: Writer inline transformations require a live browser selection and editor session. Headless MCP cannot confirm or replace that selection, so this operation always fails without changing the document.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__writer_update
tools.description: Persist authored title and/or content on an existing Writer node without calling an AI provider.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__storyboard_create
tools.description: Persist native storyboard sections and shot slots headlessly. Prompts are stored for later editing; NO images are generated.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__storyboard_decompose_screenplay
tools.description: Parse screenplay INT./EXT. sluglines into persisted editable storyboard sections and one prompt-only shot per scene. No AI or images are generated.

generateImages.description: Must be false or omitted for this headless, no-provider operation.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__storyboard_export_pdf
tools.description: Render the selected Storyboard node with the existing PDF export library, store it in the active workspace, and return verified durable file metadata. No provider generation is used.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__storyboard_export_timeline
tools.description: Export one persisted Storyboard section timeline as individual clips or clips plus an FCPXML timeline. Uses existing stored assets and the FFmpeg-aware ZIP export pipeline, stores the ZIP in the active workspace, and reports only a complete byte-verified result. Missing clip assets fail the entire export; no partial ZIP is claimed.

editorial.description: Set true to include an FCPXML timeline alongside the individual clips.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__storyboard_export_video
tools.description: Stitch the active stored video clip from each storyboard shot in shot order. Requires at least two clips stored in the active workspace; verifies the stitched workspace object before returning its signed download URL and SHA-256.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__storyboard_export_zip
tools.description: Export the selected Storyboard node as a durable workspace ZIP containing its active stored shot images (when available) and a JSON shot manifest. No provider generation is used.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__storyboard_process_frame
tools.description: Edit one shot prompt or queue a billed, idempotent headless keyframe generation for a persisted storyboard shot.

idempotencyKey.description: Required for generation; reuse only for an exact retry.

sourceNodeIds.description: Optional same-canvas source anchors recorded as provenance on the generated shot version.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__storyboard_to_presentation
tools.description: Create a native editable Presentation node with one slide per storyboard shot, using authorized stored stills when available and preserving prompts as speaker notes. No images are generated. To deliver the storyboard to Google Slides, use the returned Presentation nodeId with writer.export_presentation and format "google-slides".

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__flow_add_node
tools.description: Add a node to a Flow Studio workflow.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__flow_connect
tools.description: Wire two Flow Studio nodes (source.output → target.input).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__flow_create
tools.description: Create a new Flow Studio workflow node on the canvas.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__flow_execute_workflow
tools.description: Execute a Flow Studio workflow end-to-end.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__flow_run
tools.description: Execute a Flow Studio workflow end-to-end. (Alias of flow.execute_workflow.)

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__operation_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of Basic image/video (including Gemini Omni Prompt Studio), character 3D, audio, writing, or Presentation media operations. Gemini Omni jobs are non-resumable; an interrupted provider call is failed and refunded rather than replayed. Upscale cancellation is unavailable because its provider call cannot be safely aborted. Poll operation.get for the terminal status.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__operation_get
tools.description: Get persisted progress, terminal status, error, and output references for a Basic image, video (including Gemini Omni Prompt Studio), character 3D, audio, writing, or Presentation media operation after reconnecting.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__library_add
tools.description: Promote a canvas media node with a durable workspace storage path to the active workspace library. Personal and cross-workspace media paths are rejected.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__library_search
tools.description: Search assets saved in the active workspace library by name, character name, caption, or tags. Requires workspace access; never searches personal assets.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__library_search_assets
tools.description: Search assets saved in the active workspace library by name, character name, caption, or tags. Requires workspace access; never searches personal assets. (Alias of library.search.)

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__publish_create_draft
tools.description: Persist a Basic Publishing node and authored title/description/privacy. This does not upload, connect an account, or publish externally; platform defaults to YouTube.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__publish_get_status
tools.description: Read a durable Basic Publishing receipt and re-verify its destination against the selected platform for the authenticated user.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__publish_submit
tools.description: Publish the authorized video connected to a Basic Publishing node through its guarded platform publishing service. Supports YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram. Requires an idempotencyKey; returns a persisted receipt and verified destination state.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__publish_update_draft
tools.description: Persist title, description, or privacy on an existing Basic Publishing node. Does not upload or publish externally.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__recipe_list
tools.description: List saved agent recipes available in the current workspace (built-in + user/workspace-scoped).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__recipe_run
tools.description: MANUAL-ONLY: saved agentRecipes are interactive Canvas Agent instructions, not a typed Basic Prompt Studio job spec. Headless MCP refuses to execute their action plan. Use the recipe through the interactive Canvas Agent.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__recipe_save
tools.description: MANUAL-ONLY: this MCP request has no recent Canvas Agent prompt/tool sequence to save, and key/title do not provide a validated agentRecipes RecipeBody. Use a UI flow that supplies a complete agent recipe body; Prompt Studio prompt recipes are a separate feature.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__recipes_list
tools.description: List saved agent recipes available in the current workspace (built-in + user/workspace-scoped). (Alias of recipe.list.)

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__recipes_run
tools.description: MANUAL-ONLY — alias of recipe.run; same restriction applies.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__workspace_list
tools.description: List every workspace the current user has access to (owned + member).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__workspace_switch
tools.description: Mark a workspace id as active for the remainder of this MCP session. The new id is returned and applied to subsequent canvas tool calls. The stdio transport persists this for the process lifetime; the HTTP transport requires the client to re-send `x-scratchbox-workspace-id` to make it stick across reconnects.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__auth_whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated user, current workspace id, and tier. Use this to confirm the session is valid before calling write tools.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__brand_kit_export_png
tools.description: Render the selected Brand Kit fields and authorized workspace logo assets into a PNG, persist it, and verify the stored bytes before returning a download. No provider calls or live spend.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__character_generate_voiceover
tools.description: Generate a short voice-over using a configured Google prebuilt voice. A Basic Spoken Audio source node and billed durable synthesis job are persisted before generation; completed audio is saved to workspace storage and the canvas. Requires a writable workspace and stable idempotencyKey. Maximum 500 characters.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__character_image_to_3d
tools.description: Queue a billed, cancellable image-to-3D job from the workspace image linked to a Basic Character Sheet. The completed model is saved to the workspace and attached to that sheet. Requires a stable idempotencyKey; no generation is claimed until operation.get reports completion.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__character_promote_to_library
tools.description: Promote a generated Basic Character Sheet and its stored reference views to a workspace Character asset. Requires editor access and workspace-owned storage paths; does not read or write personal assets.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__composition_build_deck
tools.description: Queue an idempotent, billed AI layout/copy job from selected cards on the active canvas. The worker persists a real editable Presentation node and reports its node id only after saving.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__composition_create
tools.description: Persist an editable Basic Presentation node containing text-only slides and speaker notes. No AI layout, media generation, exports, or external service calls.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__composition_create_ref_sheet
tools.description: Persist a Basic Character Sheet node with authored subject name/description and settings. This creates a brief only; angle images and other generated media remain manual.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__composition_update_ref_sheet
tools.description: Persist authored fields on an existing Basic Character Sheet. Does not generate views or images.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__frame_cancel_run
tools.description: Request cancellation of a Basic frame run and its active durable child operations. Poll frame.get_run until the group reaches a terminal state.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__frame_export_zip
tools.description: Download durable child assets of a Basic frame from the active workspace, package their actual bytes into a ZIP, and persist the ZIP with byte-for-byte verification. No provider calls or live spend.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__frame_extract_palette
tools.description: Extract dominant colors from actual image-card bytes in a Basic frame and persist the JSON palette with byte-for-byte verification. Requires at least one supported image child. No provider calls or live spend.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__frame_get_run
tools.description: Read persisted aggregate and per-child status for a Basic frame run on the selected canvas.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__frame_run_children
tools.description: Start a durable Basic frame run over a bounded set of direct children. Only explicitly whitelisted, workspace-guarded Basic durable tasks are accepted (toolName enum covers storyboard frames, Prompt Studio image/video, transcription, restyle-with-preset, character ref views/sheets/3D/voiceover, deep write, presentation media/deck, location imagery/scout, image restyle/upscale/edit/reimagine/remove-object/animate/compose, illustration interpret, and audio sfx/lyrics/extend/edit/restyle/scorebox/dialogue/podcast). Each child is independently bound to its exact node, idempotent, spend-capped, persisted, cancellable, and polled to a terminal state.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__glossary_get
tools.description: Return a single approved Craft Glossary term by its slug.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__glossary_search
tools.description: Search approved Craft Glossary terms by name or category. Returns up to `limit` matches (default 10).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__learned_preferences_get
tools.description: Read the active learned preferences for the current canvas. Returns a `getLearnedPreferences` canvas action consumed by the client to surface the in-memory list (no DB write).

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__reference_library_search
tools.description: Search the current user's reference assets by text. Returns up to `limit` matches (default 10). Authorization: results are scoped to the authenticated user — the `userId` filter is rejected when it does not match the caller (no IDOR).

userId.description: Optional filter — must match the authenticated user. Cross-user reads are rejected.

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__reference_search
tools.description: Search the current user's reference assets by text. Returns up to `limit` matches (default 10). Authorization: results are scoped to the authenticated user. (Alias of reference.library_search.)

tools.name: mcp__scratchbox__prompt_studio_run_saved_recipe
tools.description: Execute a supported saved Prompt Studio Image Generator recipe using persisted node mode. Image recipes queue 1–4 independent durable Nano Banana Pro jobs and accept authorized workspace-stored image references from persisted node refs, connected image cards, and promoted image @mentions. Video recipes run through guarded Gemini Omni on the Vertex AI Interactions API with the same reference sources; 3–10 second clips and 16:9 or 9:16 ratios are supported. Browser-local files, masks, URL-only inputs, and non-image connected context are rejected. Poll operation.get or request operation.cancel for the returned operationId. This does not execute legacy agentRecipes.

aspectRatio.description: Optional explicit ratio override; otherwise uses the persisted node ratio or 16:9.

count.description: Number of independent outputs; defaults to 4 for image mode (matching Prompt Studio) and 1 for video mode.

duration.description: Gemini Omni video duration in seconds, from 3 to 10; defaults to 8.
